title: Pivot Announces Its New Road Bike: Pivot Pravia
content:
Pivot Cycles introduces the all-new Pravia, a World Tour-inspired road bike engineered to deliver race-level speed, efficiency and handling in a position riders can sustain beyond the opening miles.

Pivot Pravia Quick Hits

  • Clearance:
    • 700x38mm 2x
    • 70x40mm 1X
    • Spec 700x32mm
  • Hidden fender mounts
  • UDH
  • Not compatible with mechanical groups
  • Front Derailleur mount fits upto 50t
    • Long FD mounts available for 52t+
  • Toolshed in-frame storage (two bags included)
  • Proprietary D shaped seatpost
  • T47 bottom bracket
  • Builds:
    • Team Red AXS $11,999.00
    • Pro Force AXS $8,499.00
    • Ride Rival AXS $5,999.00
    • Frameset $4,599.oo
  • Colors: Purple Prism, Stealth Black Gloss

Built to turn every watt into forward momentum, Pravia features a carbon frame engineered using Finite Element Analysis and Pivot’s Hollow Core Molding process. Modern tube shaping reduces drag, while Pro Tour-level bottom bracket stiffness delivers immediate acceleration and efficient power transfer. A custom tapered aero fork balances sprint-ready stiffness with compliance. Pivot’s proprietary Ride Tuning ensures every frame size receives its own tuned shapes and carbon layup, creating consistent ride quality and handling across the complete size range.

Pravia pairs that race-level stiffness and handling with geometry designed around real riders and the positions they can actually sustain. Because speed is not just about how aero you can get for five minutes. It is about how fast you can still ride after two, three or five hours. A proprietary D-shaped seatpost adds aerodynamic efficiency and tuned compliance, while clearance for up to 700x38c tires in 2x configurations and 700x40c in 1x gives riders more freedom to match the bike to the roads they ride. Integrated in-frame storage keeps ride essentials cleanly inside the frame, eliminating the need to strap bags or gear to the bike and helping maintain its aerodynamic profile.

Three race-ready builds, Team, Pro and Ride, bring the Pravia platform to riders with performance-focused specifications throughout the range. All builds feature carbon wheels and power meters, while the Team and Pro models receive an integrated one-piece bar and stem with the rider selecting their preferred size at the time of order. A frameset option is also available.

Find out more at Pivot.
